story.titleZh: 加斯利和科拉平托因未减速避让黄旗被罚
story.summaryZh: 加斯利和科拉平托在墨西哥大奖赛中被罚停赛和10秒时间罚分，均因未减速避让黄旗。两人均被扣除积分。
story.originalTitle: Gasly gets a stop and go penalty and Colapinto a 10-second time penalty imposed after the race, both for failing to slow for yellow flags. Both drop o...
story.summaryEn:
Gasly gets a stop and go penalty and Colapinto a 10-second time penalty imposed after the race, both for failing to slow for yellow flags. Both drop out of points
Promotes Lawson to P7, Bortoleto to P8, Hadjar to P9, and Ryo Hirakawa gets a point on debut in P10! #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh:
加斯利因未能为黄旗减速而获得一次停赛和10秒的罚时，科拉平托也因同样原因在赛后被处以10秒的罚时。两人均未能获得积分
提升劳森至第7位，博托莱托至第8位，哈吉尔至第9位，而里奥·伊拉卡瓦在首秀中获得了第10位并得到一分！#F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
detailEn:
Gasly gets a stop and go penalty and Colapinto a 10-second time penalty imposed after the race, both for failing to slow for yellow flags. Both drop out of points
Promotes Lawson to P7, Bortoleto to P8, Hadjar to P9, and Ryo Hirakawa gets a point on debut in P10! #F1 #MexicoGP
